_comment: Store-build constants of the public instance (onboarding and trust design §0.3, §4.4; spec 01 §5.3). The one in-repo source: every app's build reads this file. A value that starts with "PLACEHOLDER:" does not exist yet; a store build MUST refuse to ship while any value starts with it. instanceId and card0Hash are recorded at the cut-over from the device that signed card 0 (never from a fetch); the Android application id awaits the owner's confirmation.

PUBLIC_INSTANCE.instanceId: PLACEHOLDER: the uuid andvari setup writes for the public instance, recorded at the cut-over
PUBLIC_INSTANCE.card0Hash: PLACEHOLDER: lowercase hex SHA-256 of card 0, taken from the signing device at the cut-over
PUBLIC_INSTANCE.name: andvari
